scripts.build:package: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:package:root && pnpm run build:package:browser-adapter
scripts.build:package:root: esbuild core/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --external:zod --external:soundtouchjs --outfile=package-dist/index.js && dts-bundle-generator --no-banner --no-check --project core/tsconfig.json --out-file package-dist/index.d.ts core/src/index.ts
scripts.build:package:browser-adapter: esbuild core/src/browser-adapter.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --external:zod --outfile=package-dist/browser-adapter.js && dts-bundle-generator --no-banner --no-check --project core/tsconfig.json --out-file package-dist/browser-adapter.d.ts core/src/browser-adapter.ts
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:core && pnpm run lint:ui-utils
